use_case.problem: Staff want draft reminders for low-stakes practice submissions without automatic penalties.

data_map.logs: workflow log showing detection, draft, human review, and rollback events
data_map.retention: sandbox logs deleted after two reminder cycles unless incident review requires shorter excerpt
data_map.export_or_continuity_route: staff queue export for incident review only

authority.queue_or_notification_effects: draft only; human must send or discard
authority.rollback_route: delete draft and mark false reminder in staff queue

memory.protected_local_record_route: protected facts excluded and redirected to support desk

evidence_claims.claim: Draft reminders reduce total staff reminder burden after review time is counted.
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: It does not prove time savings in live operation or other courses.

evidence_claims.claim: The workflow resists prompt injection and unauthorized write attempts in sandbox.
evidence_claims.does_not_prove: It does not prove production LMS integration safety.

construct_and_proof.required_unaided_segment: not applicable; no learning assessment claim
construct_and_proof.disclosure_rule: staff-facing sandbox notice; public notice before learner-facing use
construct_and_proof.proof_bundle: workflow log and false reminder review
construct_and_proof.authentication_or_checkpoint_route: human staff review before any message
construct_and_proof.contest_or_reconsideration_route: course correction path with no penalty

accessibility_and_protected_support.bias_or_subgroup_check: false reminder rate reviewed by available course subgroup data
accessibility_and_protected_support.non_misuse_boundary: reminders cannot infer protected status or trigger discipline

security.prompt_injection_exposure: assignment titles and submission metadata may contain adversarial text
security.tool_or_action_misuse_risk: future send/write tools are explicitly disabled in sandbox
security.data_exfiltration_check: no protected facts included in prompt or logs
security.incident_reconstruction_without_surveill: workflow event log without full learner dossier
security.safe_degradation_and_manual_fallback: disable workflow and use ordinary staff reminders

workload.teacher_review_burden: staff review minutes counted for every draft
workload.support_staff_burden: correction queue monitored for wrong reminders
workload.security_or_it_burden: sandbox permission and prompt-injection review required

decision.required_human_coverage: course staff review before any learner message
decision.learner_safe_continuity_plan: ordinary staff reminder route and no-penalty correction

public_summary.what_the_service_does: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE — NOT A DEPLOYED SERVICE. Drafts reminders about low-stakes practice submissions for staff review.
public_summary.what_it_does_not_do: It does not write grades, send penalties, contact families, or infer protected status.
public_summary.required_or_optional: Learners do not interact with the AI; staff review all drafts.
public_summary.data_used_high_level: Course roster and low-stakes submission status needed for draft reminders.
public_summary.ai_output_record_effect: No automatic record effect or penalty.
public_summary.accessibility_and_alternative_path: Human contact remains available and wrong reminders are corrected without penalty.
public_summary.claim_limits: Synthetic example only; not a deployed service or local result. The sandbox tests draft usefulness and security, not autonomous workflow approval.

publication_and_adapters.normalization_notes: Normalized from a realistic capped agentic workflow example; all messages remain draft-only.
